description: La navette fluviale - Liège is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données présente les informations suivantes: les géolocalisations et adresses des arrêts ainsi que les horaires de passage de la Navette fluviale. Les informations sont régulièrement vérifiées par nos services sur le terrain. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are navette fluviale, bateau, navette, fleuve, Meuse, traversée. The portal shows 6 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-05-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
